sections.heading: What information we collect
content: When you use themcq, we collect information necessary to provide you with our AI-powered study tools:
• Account information — your email address used for magic link authentication.
• Uploaded content — PDF lecture files and study materials you upload to generate MCQs, flashcards, and essays.
• Study activity — your quiz attempts, flashcard reviews, confidence ratings, and performance data used to power spaced repetition (FSRS) and analytics.
• Payment information — transaction records processed via Wayl.io (ZainCash / FIB). We do not store your full payment credentials.
• Device information — basic technical data like browser type and IP address for security and analytics purposes.
We do not require your name, phone number, or any government ID to use themcq. Your email is the only personal identifier we need.

sections.heading: How we use your information
content: We use the data we collect strictly to operate and improve themcq:
• Generating AI-powered MCQs, flashcards, and study materials from your uploaded PDFs.
• Tracking your study performance and powering spaced repetition scheduling.
• Processing subscription payments and managing your billing status.
• Sending authentication links to your email. We do not send marketing spam.
• Improving our AI models and question quality based on aggregated, anonymized usage patterns.
• Detecting and preventing fraud or abuse of the platform.
We do not use your content to train third-party AI models without your explicit consent.

sections.heading: Data storage & security
content: themcq is hosted on a VPS server. Your data is stored in a PostgreSQL database and transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections via Cloudflare.
• All traffic is encrypted in transit using TLS.
• Authentication uses secure magic links — no passwords are stored.
• Payment webhooks are verified using HMAC signatures.
• We retain your uploaded PDFs only as long as necessary to generate your study materials.

Honest note: themcq is an early-stage product. While we follow security best practices, we are not a large enterprise with a dedicated security team. We will notify you promptly in the event of any data breach affecting your account.

sections.heading: Sharing your data
content: We do not sell your personal data. Ever. We share limited information only with:
• AI providers (e.g. OpenRouter, Groq) — your uploaded content is sent to generate study materials. These providers have their own privacy policies.
• Wayl.io — our payment processor for handling ZainCash and FIB transactions in Iraq.
• Cloudflare — for CDN and DDoS protection.
• Legal authorities — only if required by applicable law and with proper legal process.

sections.heading: Your rights
content: You have control over your data on themcq:
• Access — you can request a copy of the data we hold about you.
• Deletion — you can request full deletion of your account and associated data at any time.
• Export — you can export your flashcards and study history.
• Correction — you can update your account information.
To exercise any of these rights, contact us at support@themcq.xyz.

sections.heading: Cookies & tracking
content: themcq uses minimal cookies necessary for authentication and session management. We do not use third-party advertising cookies or behavioral tracking pixels.
We may use basic, privacy-respecting analytics to understand how the platform is used in aggregate — not individual user profiling.

sections.heading: Age & eligibility
content: themcq is intended for university students aged 18 and above.
We do not knowingly collect data from users under 13. If we become aware that a user is under 13, we will delete their account and data immediately.
We do not verify age at registration. By creating an account, you confirm you meet the eligibility requirement.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
content: We may update this Privacy Policy as themcq evolves. When we make significant changes, we will notify you via the email associated with your account.
Continued use of themcq after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: Acceptance of terms
content: By accessing or using themcq (available at themcq.xyz), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the platform.
These terms apply to all users, including free and paid subscribers.

sections.heading: Description of service
content: themcq is an AI-powered study platform that allows university students to:
• Upload PDF lecture materials and exam papers.
• Generate multiple choice questions (MCQs), flashcards, and essay questions using AI.
• Track study performance with spaced repetition and analytics.
• Access an AI study coach for personalized guidance.
• Participate in shared study sessions.
We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of the service at any time with reasonable notice.

sections.heading: Account registration
content: You must provide a valid email address to create an account. You are responsible for:
• Keeping your magic link emails secure and not sharing access to your account.
• All activity that occurs under your account.
• Notifying us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.
You may not create accounts for others without their consent, or create multiple accounts to circumvent subscription limits.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
content: You agree to use themcq only for lawful educational purposes. You may not:
• Upload content you do not have the right to share.
• Attempt to reverse-engineer, scrape, or extract our AI models or generated content at scale.
• Use the platform to generate materials intended to deceive your institution.
• Attempt to hack, disrupt, or abuse the platform or its infrastructure.
• Share your subscription access with others. Each subscription is for one user.
Using AI-generated MCQs and flashcards to study for your own exams is exactly what themcq is for. We support your learning.

sections.heading: Payments & subscriptions
content: themcq offers paid subscription plans processed via Wayl.io using ZainCash or FIB.
• Billing — subscriptions are billed on a recurring basis as specified at checkout.

• Refunds — due to the nature of digital AI services, we generally do not offer refunds for completed billing periods. If you experience a significant technical issue preventing access, contact us within 48 hours.
• Cancellation — you may cancel your subscription at any time. Access continues until the end of your paid period.
• Price changes — we will notify you at least 14 days before any price increase takes effect.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
content: Your content: You retain ownership of any PDFs and study materials you upload. By uploading content, you grant themcq a limited license to process it solely for generating your study materials.

Our content: The themcq platform, its design, code, branding, and AI-generated outputs are the intellectual property of themcq. You may use generated MCQs and flashcards for personal study but may not redistribute them commercially.
AI outputs: Study materials generated from your uploaded content are yours to use for personal educational purposes.

sections.heading: Disclaimers & limitations
content: themcq is provided as is. We are an early-stage startup and cannot guarantee 100% uptime or that AI-generated content is always accurate.
themcq does not guarantee the accuracy of AI-generated content and is not responsible for academic penalties resulting from its use.

AI-generated MCQs and study materials may occasionally contain errors. Always verify critical information against your official course materials. themcq is a study aid, not a replacement for your lectures or professors.
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, themcq shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the service.

sections.heading: Termination
content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms of Service, engage in fraud or abuse, or for any other reason with reasonable notice.
You may delete your account at any time by contacting us. Upon deletion, your data will be removed within 30 days, except where retention is required by law.

sections.heading: Governing law
content: These Terms of Service are governed by the laws of the Republic of Iraq.
Any disputes shall be resolved through good-faith negotiation first. If unresolved, disputes shall be subject to the jurisdiction of Iraqi courts.
If you have any questions about these terms, contact us at support@themcq.xyz before using the service.
